categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, installation, and sales of energy-saving and environmental protection equipment. Its main product lines include slag energy-saving treatment systems, flue gas energy-saving treatment systems, full-load denitrification systems, clean energy consumption systems, desulfurization wastewater treatment systems, steel slag treatment systems, and related spare parts. The company also provides EPC (engineering, procurement, and construction) and EP (engineering and procurement) services, focusing on sectors such as power, heat, chemical, metallurgy, waste treatment, and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as axial chain transmission, scale bucket conveyor belts, closed self-cleaning technology, penetrating cooling technology, and quantitative air control. It has developed advanced systems like dry and wet slag treatment, low-temperature flue gas deep heat recovery, full-load denitrification, and zero-discharge desulfurization wastewater treatment. Production integrates digital transformation with intelligent automation, including semi-automatic roller lines, CNC machining, 5G IoT for real-time data collection, robotic arms, and AGV material transport systems to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large industrial enterprises in power generation (especially coal-fired power plants), heat supply, chemical, metallurgy, waste treatment, and new energy sectors. The company has established strong relationships with major national energy groups such as State Energy Investment Group, China Energy Engineering Group, Shanghai Electric, State Power Investment Corporation, and China Huadian Corporation. Its products and services support environmental compliance and energy efficiency upgrades in these industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within China, with significant sales in East China, North China, Northwest China, Central South, Southwest, Northeast, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and some international markets including Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore. It has established subsidiaries and joint ventures in Southeast Asia, notably in Indonesia and Singapore, to expand its global footprint and serve international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Daneng operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection equipment supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and installs specialized equipment and systems for energy-saving and pollution control, serving end customers directly or through EPC contracts. The company also engages in technology development and system integration, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the environmental protection industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D to maintain competitive advantages, focusing on energy efficiency, emission reduction, and clean energy integration. Key R&D directions include AI-driven intelligent control systems, hydrogen energy technologies, digital transformation of production, and development of advanced materials like high-thermal-conductivity PPS. It actively collaborates with universities and research institutes, holds numerous patents, and participates in national and provincial technology projects to support sustainable industrial transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of environmental protection equipment and systems, including customized orders and standard products. The company also earns income from EPC and EP engineering contracts, providing integrated design, manufacturing, installation, and commissioning services. Additionally, it receives government subsidies related to its technology and environmental contributions, and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qingdao Daneng is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in the energy-saving and environmental protection equipment sector in China, with strong technological capabilities and a diversified product portfolio. It competes with other specialized environmental equipment manufacturers and EPC contractors in the power and industrial sectors. The company holds a significant market share in coal-fired power plant environmental upgrades and is expanding into steel, chemical, and new energy markets, leveraging its innovation and quality to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.31 billion, a 27.67% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 92.97 million, up 7.26%. Total assets reached RMB 3.08 billion, growing 59.66% from the previous year, with net assets of RMB 957.79 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased market demand, new project completions, and expanded production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao Daneng emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high product quality, and comprehensive service capabilities as its key value propositions. Its products offer high efficiency, environmental compliance, and adaptability to diverse industrial conditions, including water-scarce regions and harsh operating environments. The company integrates digital intelligence and automation to enhance operational reliability and energy savings, providing customers with customized, innovative, and sustainable environmental solutions that support national carbon reduction goals.
